title: Chapter 154 The End Of The Palace
content:
Chapter 154 The End Of The Palace

As time went by, the masters of the Dome Palace seemed to understand something.

Everyone looked very ugly.

At this time, Lang Hai slowly stood up.

As the master of the Dome Palace, he must not give up at this moment.

Anyway, the ancestor can no longer be relied on. Lang Hai looked into the depths of the Palace, took a deep breath, and slowly said: "You all retreat, I can go alone."

Hearing this, everyone looked at the Palace Master with red eyes.

"Palace Master, be careful."

Lang Hai sighed, said nothing more, and went directly to the depths of the Palace.

At the same time, in the largest super palace in the Dome Palace, Lu Daosheng stood in front of the palace door, looking at the shocking scene in front of him.

If he had been like him before, he would have been shocked and could not calm down for a long time.

But after experiencing so much, he was obviously accustomed to these things.

After all, he did not sleep through these ten thousand years.

"Senior."

At this time, Lang Hai came from behind.

However, Lu Daosheng ignored Lang Hai and continued to walk into the palace.

Looking at the noble and only chair in the palace, Lu Daosheng sat on it without hesitation.

"Now we can talk."

Lu Daosheng looked calm and raised his eyebrows slightly to look at Lang Hai in the palace.

Lang Hai naturally did not dare to say a word of disapproval to Lu Daosheng sitting in his seat, and his face was still respectful.

"Senior, I am the current palace master of the Dome Palace, Lang Hai. I don't know what mistakes my Dome Palace made to annoy you. My Dome Palace will definitely pay all the price to compensate you."

He dared not say anything else now.

If you say that the other party has no connection with his Dome Palace, he will not believe it even if you kill him.

Looking at this posture, if the other party says that he will directly destroy his Dome Palace, he will not be surprised at all.

Because at this moment, he has seen a hint of murderous intent in Lu Daosheng's eyes.

Fortunately, the other party's killing intention is not very obvious, so there is still a chance to make amends.

A drop of cold sweat slowly slid down his cheek. Lang Hai was obviously extremely nervous at this moment, because Lu Daosheng mentioned Ye Lingzhi to him, and about Ye Lingzhi and his Dome Palace.

Everyone in the entire starry sky knew about it.

Although this matter seemed to be the fault of Ye Lingzhi and the Ye family.

Their Dome Palace was the victim.

But in fact, it was not. If you have to go into it, their Dome Palace was wrong first.

So, what he can do now is to pray.

Pray that the terrifying strong man in front of him is not on good terms with Ye Lingzhi, and just redress the injustice.

May the ancestors bless him.

"Ye Lingzhi, is my wife."

Lu Daosheng looked at the Dome Palace Master in front of him, Lang Hai, and slowly told the truth.

Boom!

As soon as these words came out, the last glimmer of hope in Lang Hai's heart was completely shattered, and the whole person was stunned on the spot as if struck by a bolt from the blue.

Wife!!

It's over, it's over!

The Dome Palace is finished!

Lang Hai collapsed, and finally sat directly on the ground, muttering constantly.

"Why, why is it like this..."

Looking at Lang Hai's expression, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

He did have the idea of destroying the entire Dome Palace, but he would make a decision only after understanding the truth of the year.

He would never believe that Ye Lingzhi's tragic experience had nothing to do with the Dome Palace.

"Tell me what happened in the past exactly, otherwise, you will bear the consequences."

Lu Daosheng's face was cold. Now, he just wanted to solve all this and then go back to find his wife and children.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Lang Hai's body trembled slightly, and then shook his head and smiled.

Forget it.

Life or death, let fate take its course.

"Senior, it was indeed my Qiongding Palace that was wrong..."

As Lang Hai slowly told the truth of the past, Lu Daosheng also understood it immediately.

Back then, it was indeed the young master of the Qiongding Palace who fell in love with Ye Lingzhi's beauty, so he privately approached the patriarch of the Ye clan.

For this, Ye Zhentian, the patriarch of the Ye clan, was naturally full of joy and agreed directly.

Then the palace master of the Qiongding Palace knew about this, and he did not object.

Because the young master was his only son.

Until later, the tragedy happened.

Although the Ye clan and the Qiongding Palace sent a large number of strong men to hunt down Ye Lingzhi, they still could not change the outcome of the death of the young master of the Qiongding Palace.

In the end, the palace master of the Qiongding Palace at that time became obsessed with cultivation and died in depression.

After learning that all the instigators of the year had died, Lu Daosheng sat in the palace, thinking about how he should deal with the current Qiongding Palace.

No wonder this guy looks like this, he is just a scapegoat.

He didn't do anything.

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng slowly stood up.

"Want to live?"

Lang Hai trembled all over, and couldn't believe his ears.

Is there still a chance for him to live?

Let alone the strong man who is countless times stronger than himself, even if it is himself, as long as he is a little unhappy, it is very common to kill countless lives in a moment.

So he never thought that this kind of existence in front of him would actually let him go.

"Senior, what do you need me to do?"

Langhai knew that the other party would not let him go for no reason.

So the only possibility is that he still has some value.

Hearing Langhai's words, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, and his expression of looking at Langhai also had a hint of appreciation.

This is a smart person.

It’s very comfortable to explain to smart people.

"I want you to swear to be loyal to me, to be loyal to you forever, and not to betray you."

Hearing this, Lang Hai did not hesitate and knelt down directly at Lu Daosheng, and then swears with the way of heaven.

A moment later, a deafening roar suddenly came from the void on the other side of the starry sky.

The next moment, a phantom fell from the sky and came straight into the dome palace.

"Huh? Heavenly Way?!"

Seeing the phantom, Lang Hai was shocked.

I just made a vow, how did I attract the way of heaven?

However, Tiandao did not look at Lang Hai at all, but looked at Lu Daosheng with a respectful expression.

"Sir, I'm sorry, I hope to forgive you."

When Lang Hai was heard from the way of heaven, he was shocked.

What level of thigh did I hold?

At first, he just wanted to survive, but after being loyal to Lu Daosheng, wouldn’t he be the other party’s person?

Regarding his original future, he was more convinced that the terrifying existence in front of him was a height that he would never reach in his life.

So he was not only not disgusted with being loyal to the other party, but also was also very happy.

The only thing that feels guilty is that I feel a little sorry for the ancestors of the Dome Heavenly Palace.
